backgroundColor.description: Card background HEX color. Empty string means use theme default.

effect.description: Animated visual effect attached to the card. null explicitly disables inheriting a theme-level effect; omitted means inherit the theme default.

material.description: Card surface material (Standard, Glass, …). null explicitly forces the standard material even if a theme default is set; omitted means inherit the theme default.

shadowVariant.description: Which theme shadow slot (shadow.card vs shadow.elevated) this card uses. Omitted means inherit the theme default.

variant.description: Render as a plain text block (default) or a distinct bordered card. Currently used by description_box.
